body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Vutec(www.vutec.com) showcased its all-in-one screen solution ‘Theater Art Systems’ during CES 2008.
“Theater Art Systems transforms any room into a home theater, combining framed high quality art with an automatic vertical masking system,” said Howard Sinkoff, president of Vutec.

When the artwork is retracted and motorized up, it reveals a 2.35:1 CinemaScope movie screen. That screen in turn masks a 16:9 HD format, with vertical masks that motor up on either side. The artwork ascends or descends with the touch of a remote.
